label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
Thanks Deirdre, and thank you for asking instead of just announcing it. That means a lot.

I'm not going to fight this. I understand the numbers, and Bronwyn can't do 24 on her own. But I won't pretend I'm fine about it either, I'm gutted. Noma has been in the Seahorses with me for three years, since my very first year, and she basically trained me. She's the one who sat under the jungle gym with Zayd in Term 2 when nobody else could settle him, and the kids ask for "Noma's song" at morning ring every single day. So it's a big loss for the room, not just for me.

My worry is the first few weeks. That's the hardest stretch of Grade R, with new kids crying at the gate, and a new assistant on top of a new group is a lot at once. There are two things I'd like you to put to SMT please:

1. Could Charlene come in for a day or two in the last week of term (1-4 Dec)? She could meet Noma and see the routine before we're both thrown in on 14 Jan. I know she only officially starts on the 11th, so I understand if that takes some arranging.

2. Could Noma pop across for morning ring in the first week back, from 14 Jan? Even 15 minutes would do. She's only across the courtyard, and Luthando and Mia already know her from aftercare, so a familiar face and the isiXhosa songs would really help the new group settle. Only if Bronwyn's okay with it, of course.

If those two can happen I think we'll manage, and I'll do everything I can to make Charlene feel welcome.

And Bronwyn, no hard feelings, you're getting the best. Look after her!
